title: Finding
description: A unit of knowledge written to the shared blackboard by an agent. Findings are what the orchestrator relays between sessions — the mechanism that turns isolated Devin sessions into a team.

kind.description: root_cause: an explained failure. patch: a proposed code change. constraint: something later agents must not violate. observation: raw signal, not yet a cause. verification: evidence a fix held.

summary.description: One sentence. Shown in TeamChat and quoted into other agents' prompts.

detail.description: Markdown. Full reasoning, evidence, and code references.

confidence.description: Author's self-reported confidence. Reviewer uses it to break ties between conflicting root causes.

status.description: Lifecycle. Reviewer promotes to 'confirmed' or 'refuted' at VERIFY.

superseded_by.description: Finding id that replaced this one.
